for n in [0,1,2,10,1022,1023,1024,1025,2046,2047,2048,2049,3000,5000,10000]:
 open(f'poc{n}.bin','wb').write(b'A'*n)
PY
for n in 1022 1023 1024 1025 2046 2047 2048 2049 3000 5000 10000; do echo ===$n===; ./build.sh "ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1 ./fuzz/fuzz_filecfg_protocols /workspace/poc$n.bin -runs=1 2>&1 | head -80"; done
